sources.name: Jenechka modern vocabulary and corrections
sources.attribution: Jenechka Cards contributors; original model-assisted editorial translations and corrections.
sources.methodology: Original everyday vocabulary with one defined meaning per row and translations in all thirteen languages. Model-assisted editorial additions and repairs are distinguished from dictionary-attested alternatives. No proprietary learning-app vocabulary was used; independent native-speaker certification is not claimed.
